name: Itemisation
title: Bases, modifier groups, tiers, quality, and loot
summary: 19 consolidates fixed base-specific favored-type weights; 0–6 modifiers with 3+3 major/minor limits; count-derived quality and color; item-stage tier weighting; repairable zero-durability items; and probabilistic NPC equipment recovery.
scenarioNote: Exact base and loot tables remain open.

points.text: Each base gives favored modifier types higher fixed weights and other types lower weights; character factors cannot alter those type weights.
Item Creation skill, Perception, and Luck determine the six-slot modifier-count probability under the formula in 19.
Higher item stages increase stronger-tier weights without a hard tier ceiling; major/minor assignment is random within caps and full reforge preserves group distribution.
Quality bands are count-based; labels change only at category boundaries. Normal grey, Magic green, Rare cyan, Epic purple, Legendary yellow-orange, and Unique red.
Insertion works on any base only when a free slot exists in the extracted modifier's own group.
Ordinary monsters drop ingredients only; NPC equipment is checked per item under the Luck-modified base-35% recovery formula.

gaps: Final base/weight/tier tables, modifier group distribution, exact numeric ranges/duplicate constraints, wear and repair parameters, transformed-NPC drops, and non-combat acquisition remain open.
